channel.title: Inspera incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Inspera's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Inspera Originality: Viewing internally/externally matched sources is temporarily disabled [resolved]
item.description: Viewing internally/externally matched sources is now enabled. The issue was related to indexing. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

item.title: We are currently investigating an issue with starting tests and previewing content [resolved]
Inspera Originality: Increased Processing Times for Originality Reports [resolved]
item.description: The issues regarding longer-than-usual processing times in Inspera Originality have now been fully resolved. Our technical team has cleared the submission backlog, and you should see reports appearing as expected. Thank you for your understanding during this period of high system load.

item.title: Inspera Assessment Demo Tests are currently out of service [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue, and demo tests are available for candidates again.

item.title: Delays in candidate updates in monitor [resolved]
Email message delays [resolved]
item.description: The emeail queue is now back to normal and there should be no more delay.

item.title: Proctoring events unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved.
Please Note: Customers with recordings in said interval will be informed directly once those recordings have been processed.

item.title: Inspera's Help Center is currently unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The Help Centre is operational again, and access to tickets and articles is restored.

item.title: Delays in low-priority event log updates [resolved]
item.description: The issue with delay of the low-priority event logs update has been resolved.
